# Jimwel Cruz

> Jimwel Cruz is a full-stack web developer based in the Philippines, building fast, accessible web applications and e-commerce stores with React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, and Shopify since 2023.

## Profile

- Experience: building production web applications since 2023
- Availability: open to freelance work and full-time roles

## Services

- Full-Stack Development: production-ready web applications from database to interface — schema design, APIs, authentication, and responsive React front ends.
- E-commerce Development: Shopify and custom storefronts with catalog architecture, cart and checkout flows, payment integration, and performance tuning.
- UI Implementation: pixel-accurate, responsive interfaces built from design files with reusable component systems.
- Performance Optimization: Core Web Vitals work — code splitting, image optimization, caching, and bundle analysis.
- Accessibility Audits: WCAG-oriented reviews of keyboard navigation, screen readers, contrast, and focus management, with fixes implemented.
- Responsive Design: mobile-first layouts that hold up from 320px phones to 4K monitors.

## Selected Work

- [Marrow](https://marrow-silk.vercel.app/) — Homepage design study for a streetwear label, with cinematic ink-and-ivory art direction.
- [FoxHound Bee](https://foxhound-bee.vercel.app/) — Homepage design study for a fictional apiary, with a cream-and-ember palette and hexagonal comb grid.
- [crumb.](https://crumb-drab.vercel.app/) — Homepage design study for a fictional cupcake shop, with hand-drawn outlines and a real-time 3D hero.
- [Vellora](https://vellora-seven.vercel.app/) — Multi-vendor marketplace with Stripe, real-time notifications, and role-based dashboards.
- [ModernHaven](https://modern-haven-nine.vercel.app/) — E-commerce store for modern furniture with Stripe payments and real-time inventory.
- [ContactFlow](https://contactflow-crm.vercel.app/) — CRM platform for managing customer interactions, with role-based access and analytics.

## Technology

React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PHP, Shopify / Liquid, Supabase, Prisma, Stripe, NextAuth, Three.js, Git, Vercel.
